verses.author: model_A
verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text: The porch light left on for no one in particular

verses.author: model_A
verses.text: Moths gather anyway, believing in something

verses.author: model_B
verses.text: the kettle forgets it was ever asked to boil

verses.author: model_A
verses.text: a chair by the window keeps the shape of waiting

verses.author: model_B
verses.text: dust settles on the sill like it's decided to stay

verses.author: model_A
verses.text: the clock on the wall gives up counting, just glows

verses.author: model_B
verses.text: a moth taps the glass, asking to be let into the dark
